description:
Multi use trail, primarily used for mountain biking. Open to hiking, trail running and e-bikes. Singletrack, uphill only, blue level trail. Ridden from South to North. Dog friendly trail.

Distance 1.5 km | Ascent 144m | Descent -23m
directions: Accessed from Mackenzie Basin Access Road. (50.329050, -122.782900)
title: Happy Trail
